name: Bhagavad Gita 18.20
text:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥
meaning: The knowledge by which one sees one imperishable reality in all beings, undivided in the divided: know that knowledge to be sattvic, pure.
purpose: Seeing one undivided reality in all beings.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
